title: Eight-Layer Thick-Subset Perturbation with Damped Learning
scientific_hypothesis: Phase-coupling effects in the 8 thickest layers dominate dual-band performance; constraining optimization to these layers with reduced learning rate will improve target_score without overshoot.
design_principle: Selective parameter optimization reduces search space dimensionality while targeting layers with highest optical path contribution. Damped learning rate (0.05x) suppresses oscillation near local optima.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
design_variables: Thicknesses of 8 layers with largest values from iteration_11 best candidate; remaining 16 layers fixed
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
theory_basis: Needle optimization principle: localized thickness adjustments can refine multi-wavelength performance
Gradient descent with reduced step size improves convergence near optima
expected_advantages: Targeting thick layers addresses dominant phase contributions
Damped learning prevents overshoot observed in iteration_13
known_risks: Fixing 16 layers may prevent discovery of better global configuration
8-layer subset may not contain all critical phase-coupling layers
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_11 best candidate: [92.0, 45.0, 99.0, 120.0, 69.0, 120.0, 51.0, 120.0, 119.0, 46.0, 120.0, 45.0, 120.0, 47.0, 120.0, 60.0, 120.0, 84.0, 120.0, 65.0, 120.0, 75.0, 46.0, 70.0] nm. Identify the 8 layers with largest thickness values (indices: 3,5,7,10,12,14,16,18 all at 120.0 nm, then select next largest). Constrain optimization to perturb only these 8 layers; fix remaining 16 layers at initial values. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate scaled to 0.05x of default. Apply conservative acceptance: reject any step reducing best_target_score below 0.7524 (iteration_11 historical best) by more than 3%. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized, coherent TMM. Spectral bands: 200-400 nm (maximize reflectance), 800-1500 nm (maximize transmittance). Thickness tolerance: ±15 nm absolute normal deviation for robustness. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: reinitialize from iteration_11 baseline, reduce learning rate to 0.05x, constrain to 8 thickest layers, enforce 3% acceptance threshold below historical best.
